(Currently Amended) Claim 1: An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve that is specifically configured to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve that is specifically configured to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use based on real-time operational parameters.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising plural first valves and/or plural second valves, wherein at least one of the plural first valves and/or plural second valves is configured to handle high volume air flow.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators and include an additional fail-safe feature.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and control braking force based thereon, wherein the control means dynamically adjusts braking force during vehicle operation.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors, and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to actively control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, enhancing efficiency during braking operations.
